notes: Acute ST elevation MI. Exact-matches every ACS CPG that scopes BA41.0; STEMI ranks top by scope embedding.
Acute MI (parent). Routes to the acute-coronary CPGs (was BA41.00, which is not a valid ICD-11 code).
Subsequent / chronic ischaemic heart disease. Routes to Stable CAD + PCI (was BA41.0Z, not a valid code).
Acute non-ST elevation MI. Exact-matches NSTEMI + NSTE-ACS (and PCI).
Unstable angina. Routes to NSTE-ACS (+ Stable CAD, PCI). Note: NOT NSTEMI — BA40.0 is not in the NSTEMI (BA41 only) scope. Was incorrectly BA80.0Z.
Congestive heart failure. Heart Failure CPG ranks top; broad CPGs that scope BD10 follow.
Left ventricular failure. Heart Failure CPG ranks top.

Cardiomyopathy in the puerperium (peripartum CM). Exact D1 match to Heart Disease in Pregnancy (JB44.3 added to its icd11_scope 2026-06-02). Not in the Heart Failure CPG scope by design — pregnancy-specific cardiac disease is deferred to the HDP CPG. Was BD10.1 (invalid code).
Essential hypertension. Hypertension CPG ranks top; prevention CPGs co-scope BA00 and surface in top-3.
Essential hypertension, unspecified. Same routing as BA00.
Hypertensive crisis (emergency). Routes to Hypertension CPG. Was BA04 = secondary hypertension.
Hyperlipoproteinaemia. Dyslipidaemia CPG ranks top.
Hypercholesterolaemia (incl. familial). Sibling-match to Dyslipidaemia CPG.
Hypertriglyceridaemia. Dyslipidaemia CPG. Was 5C81 (= hypolipoproteinaemia, wrong).
Mixed hyperlipidaemia. Dyslipidaemia CPG. Was 5C82 (not a valid code).
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. AF CPG ranks top. Was BC81.0 (AF CPG scope is the BC81.3 family).
Persistent atrial fibrillation. AF CPG. Was BC81.1.
Permanent atrial fibrillation. AF CPG. Was BC81.2.
Stable angina pectoris. Stable CAD CPG ranks top (+ PCI). Was BA80.0.
Angina pectoris (parent). Routes across the IHD CPGs. Was BA80 (not the angina block).
Idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension. Exact-match, single CPG.
Pulmonary hypertension (parent). PAH CPG.
Pre-eclampsia (a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy in the Heart-Disease-in-Pregnancy scope). Note label corrected: JA24 = Pre-eclampsia, not cardiac disease in pregnancy.
Mild to moderate pre-eclampsia. Ancestor-match to Heart Disease in Pregnancy.
Severe pre-eclampsia. Ancestor-match to Heart Disease in Pregnancy.
Acute or subacute infectious endocarditis. IE CPG. Was CA40 (= a pneumonia code; IE scope is BB40-BB4Z).
Myoendocarditis. IE CPG. Was CA40.0.
Periendocarditis. IE CPG. Was CA40.1.
Cerebral ischaemic stroke (parent). Ischaemic Stroke CPG ranks top.
Ischaemic stroke due to extracranial large-artery atherosclerosis. Ischaemic Stroke CPG.
Stroke not known if ischaemic or haemorrhagic. NOT in structural scope (8B11 family); recovered via D2 semantic_scope fallback to the Ischaemic Stroke CPG.
Invasive carcinoma of breast. Breast Cancer CPG ranks top; Cancer-Pain co-scopes the whole Ch.2 neoplasm branch and tags along.
Invasive ductal carcinoma of breast. Breast Cancer CPG.
Invasive carcinoma of breast, mixed ductal/lobular. Breast Cancer CPG.
Invasive lobular carcinoma of breast. Breast Cancer CPG. Was 2C61.Z (not in the curated icd11_codes table).
Malignant neoplasms of colon. Colorectal CPG ranks top; Cancer-Pain co-scopes.
Malignant neoplasms of rectum. Colorectal CPG. Was 2B91 (= rectosigmoid junction; rectum is 2B92).
Chronic cancer related pain. Cancer Pain CPG. Was MG30.0 (= chronic primary pain).
Chronic pain (parent). Recovered via D2 semantic_scope to the Cancer Pain CPG.
Malignant neoplasms of nasopharynx. NPC CPG ranks top; Cancer-Pain co-scopes.
Male erectile dysfunction, unspecified. ED CPG (scope is the HA01.1 family). Was HA00 (= hypoactive sexual desire).
Male erectile dysfunction, acquired, generalised (organic). ED CPG. Was HA00.0.
Male erectile dysfunction, acquired, situational (psychogenic). ED CPG. Was HA00.1.
Type 2 diabetes mellitus. T2DM CPG ranks top; broad CPGs that co-scope 5A11 follow. Repurposed from a duplicate BA00 entry to add diabetes routing coverage.
